product_one_liner.value: Maximum provides an AI-native operating system for banks to modernize core infrastructure, automate operational workflows with custom agents, and deliver financial products.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the navigation or footer; /pricing serves generic product messaging and a request-access prompt, not pricing plans.

named_customers.notes: Could not verify two qualifying customers or locate a customer directory, case-study collection, or relevant review listing. Design partners and investors were excluded.

employee_band.notes: TipRanks reports 11 employees as of October 26, 2026; LinkedIn also reports 11.

founded_year.notes: The company's LinkedIn profile states 2026; Dealroom and PitchBook instead report 2025. The company-reported year is used here.

eng_blog.notes: No actual blog was found: /blog serves the generic homepage, while the newsroom lists external press and investor coverage.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation, help-center, or developer-portal link appears in the homepage navigation or footer.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The listed openings are Senior Staff Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, and Senior Software Engineer; none has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No named model or provider was disclosed in the reviewed product material, privacy disclosures, careers page, or announcements; no public documentation or named subprocessor list was found.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy describes security safeguards but names none of the five specified compliance standards.

raised_18mo.notes: The $30 million Seed round announced August 3, 2026 falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists only software-engineering openings, with no SDR, BDR, or account-executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Maximum publicly introduced its banking operating system and emerged from stealth on August 3, 2026, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete, dated leadership roster or verifiable C-level/VP appointment or departure was found for the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable engineering job descriptions name no CRM or sales and marketing systems.
